description:
Calculate RS3 resale-profit scenarios after seller tax. ESTIMATE ONLY; never places an order. Use get_item_details for current records/comparisons or lookup_item to resolve names.

- itemId=4151 means Abyssal whip, not a quantity. quantity scales total investment, tax and profit without changing per-unit margin.
- Omitting both prices gives identical buy/sell prices, usually a tax loss. Supply itemId and both prices to calculate without network access.
- Seller tax is 2% of each unit's sell price, rounded down. Bonds and sales at 50 coins or less are exempt.
- With quantity=20 and buyLimitRemaining=5, quota profit covers five units while requested totals still cover twenty. fillTimeMinutes converts full-request profit into an hourly rate, including assumed quota waits. Both inputs are caller assumptions, not observed limits or fill predictions.
- Sampled prices lag live offers. Reads are uncached and require no credentials. HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute; wait for Retry-After after 429.

buyLimitRemaining.description: Caller-supplied remaining purchase quota in the current buy-limit window; 0 means none available

buyPrice.description: Buy price per item in coins. Defaults to the latest Weirdgloop sample, then Jagex guide price.

fillTimeMinutes.description: Caller-assumed minutes to buy and resell the full requested quantity, including any quota waits

itemId.description: Known GE item ID resolved with lookup_item

sellPrice.description: Sell price per item in coins. Defaults to the latest Weirdgloop sample, then Jagex guide price.

name: estimate_flip

outputSchema.description: Flip estimate after the RS3 2% seller tax. marginPct is null when the buy cost is 0.

buyPrice.description: Buy price per item in coins

executionScenario.description: Present only for caller-supplied capacity or duration scenarios; not a market prediction

assumedNetProfitPerHour.description: Full requested profit divided by caller-assumed round-trip hours

netProfitWithinBuyLimit.description: Tax-adjusted profit on the quantity executable within the supplied quota

sellPrice.description: Sell price per item in coins

title: Estimate Flip Profit
